text:
jess: seeing intermittent tail-latency spikes on long-chat workloads with m7b sliding-window. spikes only when seq > ~1500, throughput drops ~25%.

sam: nice catch. did you repro locally with the same quant/profile?

jess: yes, repro on dedicated staging (prod-like GPUs). attached quick perf dump: kernel selector flips at the same boundary each time.

jess: profiling snippet:
```
seq=1536 -> kernel_choice: matmul_gemm_naive  68% tokens
seq=1520 -> kernel_choice: optimized_tile_gemm  85% tokens
kv_cache_hits ~ stable
prefetch_slabs: warmup occasionally fails to pin page -> extra memcpy
```

dan: matmul_gemm_naive should only be chosen for very narrow dims. could be due to rope_rescale flag toggling an internal heuristic. any config differences in the model_compat shim?

jess: model.cfg has: `rope_scale: 1.0` on most runs. the failing runs show `rope_scale: 0.997` (probably from runtime rounding/scale override).

maria: who set the runtime override? we recently added soft-rescale for Mixtral compatibility. @lee?

lee: that was me — the soft-rescale patch tries to avoid pos-wrap by nudging rope when max_pos is near boundary. intended for qwen/mixtral but applied to all Mistral variants.

sam: aha. the selector uses an analytic cost model that depends on head dim and effective rotary scale. small rescale nudges head/block shape heuristics -> picks naive kernel.

jess: reproducer steps I used (minimal):
```bash
# start a long convo workload
./perf_runner --model mistral7b --max_seq 2500 --sliding_window 1024 --rope_scale 0.997 --batch 8
```

infra-bot: deploy 169 -> canary applied to staging at 1719009600 by lee.

dan: fix options:
- revert soft-rescale for Mistral models (quick)
- or extend kernel selector to ignore tiny rope_scale deltas (<0.01) when computing kernel heuristics (safer)
- or add a small warmup that pins prefetch slabs earlier to avoid memcpy jitter (mitigation)

maria: +1 to the selector tolerance change. less risky and covers other micro-deltas.

lee: can do selector patch. will add a threshold check: if abs(rope_scale - 1.0) < 0.01 -> treat as 1.0 for kernel heuristics. also add a unit test around head/block dim decision.

jess: once patched can we run the long-chat perf suite (10k tokens aggregated) and confirm no >10% throughput regressions?

lee: will run after signoff. ETA ~2h. posting results here.

sam: also file an issue to make soft-rescale opt-in per model family. we don't want accidental cross-model heuristics.

jess: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:

lee: quick update: patch applied to staging at 1719010100. preliminary run shows kernel_choice stays on optimized_tile_gemm at seq 1536, and tail latency stable. I'll run full perf and upload traces.

jess: awesome — please paste flamegraphs when ready.

infra-bot: perf job 789 completed (success). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/789

lee: artifacts look good. baseline vs patched: p95 latency -2.3%, throughput +6% on long chats. closing for now but will follow up with selector unit tests and a model opt-in flag for rope_rescale.

maria: great. create a short changelog entry for the release notes.

jess: filing one now. thread resolved for the moment.
